answer_1.quote: In this study, table structure recognition is viewed as a generative task, and its goal is to generate the corresponding sequence of HTML codes given a table image.
answer_1.outputs: sequence of HTML tags that represent the structure of the table

answer_2.quote: We employ three metrics to compare the predictions against the ground truth. Exact Match Accuracy (EMA)... Bilingual Evaluation Understudy Score (BLEU)... Tree-Edit-Distance-Based Similarity (TEDS)
